user.title: Set up ELRO Connects K2
user.description: Searching for an ELRO Connects K2 gateway on the local network...

confirm.title: ELRO Connects K2 found
confirm.description: Found K2 gateway at {host} (ID: {device_name}). Add it to Home Assistant?

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: No K2 gateway was found automatically. Enter the details manually.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the K2 gateway. Check the IP address and ensure nothing else is using UDP port 1025.

abort.already_configured: This K2 gateway is already configured.

start_pairing.name: Add device
start_pairing.description: Puts the K2 gateway into pairing mode and waits for a new detector to join. Trigger the detector's pairing action (usually by holding its test button) while this is running. The detector type does not need to be selected - the gateway accepts whichever device joins.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Which K2 gateway to pair with. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to keep pairing mode open while waiting for a detector to join.

cancel_pairing.name: Cancel adding device
cancel_pairing.description: Closes an open pairing window on the K2 gateway before it times out.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Which K2 gateway to stop pairing on. Can be left empty when only one is set up.
